answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 5936 Country: India Title: I am a sunni muslim boy, I want to marry a sunni muslim girl but her parents are not ready.Please Tell me some dua so that I can marry her. Please help me. Question: Assalamualaikum, I am a sunni muslim boy, I want to marry a sunni muslim girl but her parents are not ready.Please Tell me some dua so that I can marry her. Please help me. Answer ID: 5936 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1171/144=B/1429) In the abovementioned case, when her parents are not ready then you should not strive for the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
